incident_text: A house is on fire in our street. Flames are coming out of the roof and the front door.

result.scene_summary: A house is on fire with flames visible through windows and over the roof, with smoke rising. The structure shows signs of fire damage and has a porch. Vegetation is visible in the background.

observations.description: Bright orange flames engulfing the roof and visible through windows and doorways.
White smoke rising from the roof area near the fire.
Roof is partially collapsed and charred; porch columns and siding are damaged.
Single-story house with siding, windows, and a porch; a chimney is visible in the background.
Trees and greenery visible in the background behind the house.
A wooden panel lies on the ground to the right side of the house.
